title: Into the Unknown: Benchmarking AI agents on open scientific research problems
abstract: arXiv:2610.19159v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Can AI agents carry out research on open scientific problems? We introduce Into the Unknown, a benchmark that provides an agent with a science paper along with a research direction to pursue and tasks it to write a follow-up paper. We work with scientists at US Department of Energy (DOE) national laboratories, who each contribute an unpublished follow-up direction from their own work together with the necessary conditions a submission must meet. While assessing the quality of a follow-up paper is challenging in general, using these conditions to form a rubric makes evaluation more tractable for research problems that have no reference answer. We have nine frontier agents write 15 follow-ups each, spanning quantum computing, plasma physics, computational chemistry, materials science, and scientific machine learning domains. translated_title: 进入未知领域：在开放科学研究问题上对AI智能体进行基准测试
translated_abstract: AI智能体能够对开放性科学问题开展研究吗？我们推出了"Into the Unknown"（进入未知领域）基准测试，该基准为智能体提供一篇科学论文以及一个待探索的研究方向，并要求其撰写一篇后续论文。我们与美国能源部（DOE）国家实验室的科学家合作，每位科学家都贡献了自己工作中一个未发表的后续研究方向，以及投稿必须满足的必要条件。虽然评估一篇后续论文的质量总体上具有挑战性，但利用这些条件形成评分准则，使得对没有参考答案的研究问题的评估更加可行。我们让九个前沿智能体各自撰写15篇后续论文，涵盖量子计算、等离子体物理、计算化学、材料科学和科学机器学习等领域。在135篇投稿中，没有一篇满足所有条件，其中114篇未通过我们的完整性检查，最常见的原因是……
tldr: 该论文推出了"Into the Unknown"基准测试，通过与能源部国家实验室科学家合作定义未发表的后续研究方向及评分准则，评估九个前沿AI智能体在开放科学问题上撰写后续论文的能力，结果显示135篇投稿无一满足全部条件，其中114篇未通过完整性检查。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces "Into the Unknown," a benchmark that tasks nine frontier AI agents with writing follow-up papers on open scientific problems contributed by DOE national lab scientists, finding that none of the 135 submissions met all required conditions and 114 failed the integrity check.
